diagnoses.label: Q02 representative thermocouple selection misaligned with TAL intent
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Location hint flags “Q02 的代表热电偶选择部分”. In SKILL.md, deterministic sensor selection says: “If selecting minimum metric (e.g., ‘coldest’ TAL or peak): choose (min_value, smallest_tc_id).” This implies TAL should use the minimum TAL thermocouple, but the task asks to compute TAL per run and report tc_id; handbook may define representative sensor differently (e.g., cold spot by peak or by location), and the current guidance hard-codes TAL as a min-metric example without tying it to handbook-defined ‘representative’/‘worst case’ logic.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Representative thermocouple selection / worst-case sensor rule
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Question 2 (TAL) run-level tc_id selection when multiple thermocouples exist
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Q01 ramp (max metric) and Q03 peak (min peak) selection rules unless handbook explicitly aligns them
diagnoses.target_section: Deterministic thermocouple computation recipes -> 4. Deterministic sensor selection (tie-breaks) (and any Q02/TAL-specific wording)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Clarify a TAL-specific selection mechanism that is explicitly conditional on handbook guidance (e.g., choose cold-spot TC as defined by handbook; if handbook defines worst-case for TAL as minimum TAL then use min(TAL), otherwise follow stated criterion). Keep deterministic tie-breaks but avoid asserting TAL is inherently a min-metric without handbook grounding.

diagnoses.label: Delivery/acceptance criteria for required output files under-specified
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Location hint flags “交付物和任务完成条件”. The task requires generating five specific files (/app/output/q01.json ... q05.json) with strict formatting (rounding, sorting, null handling). SKILL.md provides general “Output construction guardrails” and a scaffold, but does not explicitly enumerate the deliverables nor define completion checks per question (e.g., must write all five JSONs, schema adherence, required keys, and failure handling like ‘If a run has no thermocouple data, it is failing’ for Q03).
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Deliverables & task completion conditions (output contract enforcement)
diagnoses.scope_boundary: End-to-end execution for Questions 1–5: writing q01–q05 JSON files with required schemas and constraints
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Other skills/bundles that do not require file-based deliverables under /app/output
diagnoses.target_section: Output construction guardrails / (add explicit Deliverables & Completion Criteria section)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add an explicit deliverables checklist mapping Q01–Q05 to exact output paths and schema obligations, plus completion criteria (all files written, sorted, 2dp rounding, nulls not NaN, and Q03 missing-TC => failing). Reference existing guardrails rather than duplicating logic.

overlay.primary_anchor: Representative thermocouple selection / worst-case sensor rule
overlay.composition_issue: Ambiguous TAL sensor-selection guidance can cascade into incorrect Q02 tc_id and tal_s, which then affects downstream compliance status and potentially Q05 best-run selection; missing explicit deliverables/completion criteria increases risk of producing incomplete or non-conformant outputs even if computations are correct.
preservation_constraints: Preserve existing deterministic tie-break principle (stable tc_id ordering) where applicable
Preserve interpolation-based TAL computation guidance and dt<=0 segment skipping
Preserve rounding/sorting/null guardrails and the minimal scaffold structure

package_assessment.rationale: Defects are localized to documentation/mechanism guidance in reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit/SKILL.md (sensor-selection decision logic and explicit deliverable/acceptance criteria). Strengthening these mechanisms does not require changing external data or adding new tools, and can be addressed by clarifying handbook-conditional rules and output contract checks.
